mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating an accommodative monetary policy stance) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals an economic slowdown that prompts monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing construction (HOUST > 2000) and real consumption (RSAFS > 340000) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when both HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 340000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 120), the economy experiences strong corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The mechanism is active only in this regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 120, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of the unemployment rate (indicating a tight labor market) signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 190) indicates a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 190, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (INDPRO) falls below 115, it signals an economic contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to declining corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 115, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
